summary: The PR addresses the issue of unnecessary post_init signal handling in ImageField when width_field and height_field are not set, which can improve performance. The change is well-targeted and passes all tests.

issues.description: The new reproduction script `reproduce.py` is added but not included in the diff as per instructions. While this is not a blocking issue, it might be useful to include it in the repository or reference it appropriately.
The change could benefit from a comment explaining why the signal handler is conditionally connected based on the presence of width_field and height_field.
